items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...I know you know Sol. What do you think of Buddy... [INTERVIEWEE] Sol is definitely a percussionist... I didn't know anything about tuning drums until I got with a saxophone

ctx.x: And of course Buddy Rich, if we can just review! In this new day of television and recordings and precisionists, a young lad came along who Buddy thought a great deal of. I'm sure you did too, how about Sol Gubin?

Sol is definitely a percussionist... When you say a percussionist, a guy that can play whatever it is and can tune these drums and what have you. I didn't know anything about tuning drums until I got with a saxophone
